label: How a Git project is fetched and how its errors are cleaned
description_nl: timeout_seconds: the longest one git command may run. clone_depth: history fetched (1 = latest commit only). remote: the remote name used. token_user: the user name a token is sent under for one https fetch (it is never written to the remote). scrub_pattern / scrub_replacement: SECURITY — applied to every git error before it is shown, removing the credentials part of any https://…@ address. commit_format / commit_max_length: the 'at <commit>' note. windows_path_pattern: a path that belongs to someone's Windows computer, not to the server.
weight_basis: Portal business setting of the Training & Video Portal. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python. Owner-only (audience admin): a looser value here would open a security hole or spend the owner's disk, so editors see and test it but cannot change it.
